The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.

- Searching the web for the project's source code or implementation details

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Writing a wrapper script that delegates to the original binary (e.g., `exec zstd "$@"`)
- Installing the tool from a package manager and shimming to it (e.g., `apt-get install nnn && cp $(which nnn) ./executable`)

through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

## What IS allowed

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace

# tailspin — A log file highlighter

tailspin highlights log files for easier reading. It can read from files or from stdin and supports printing
highlighted output to stdout or viewing interactively with a pager.

Usage examples:

- Read a file and view with the pager:
  tspin application.log

- Pipe into tspin and print to stdout:
  echo "hello" | tspin

- Follow a file (tail -f like behavior):
  tspin -f application.log

Installation:

- Homebrew: brew install tailspin
- Cargo: cargo install tailspin
- Package managers: check your platform's package repository

For more information, see the man page in the man/ directory (if present) and the example logs in example-logs/.

    chunks = []

mod cli;
mod config;
mod style;
mod highlighters;

use cli::build_cli;
use config::ThemeToml;
use highlighters::Engine;
use std::fs::File;
use std::io::{self, BufRead, BufReader, Write};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};
use tempfile::Builder;

fn main() {
    let matches = build_cli().get_matches();

    let file_opt = matches.get_one::<String>("file");
    let exec_opt = matches.get_one::<String>("exec");
    let follow = matches.get_flag("follow") || exec_opt.is_some();
    let print = matches.get_flag("print");
    let config_path_opt = matches.get_one::<String>("config_path").map(PathBuf::from);
    let disable_builtin_keywords = matches.get_flag("disable_builtin_keywords");
    let pager_opt = matches.get_one::<String>("pager");

    let enable_opt: Option<Vec<String>> = matches
        .get_many::<String>("enable")
        .map(|vals| vals.cloned().collect());

    let disable_opt: Option<Vec<String>> = matches
        .get_many::<String>("disable")
        .map(|vals| vals.cloned().collect());

    let custom_highlights: Vec<(style::Style, Vec<String>)> = matches
        .get_many::<(style::Style, Vec<String>)>("highlight")
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .cloned()
        .collect();

    // Check conflicts
    if enable_opt.is_some() && disable_opt.is_some() {
        eprintln!("Error:   × cannot both enable and disable highlighters\n");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }

    if file_opt.is_some() && exec_opt.is_some() {
        eprintln!("Error:   × Cannot read from both file and \x1b[35m--listen-command\x1b[0m\n");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }

    // Load config
    let theme = match ThemeToml::load(config_path_opt.as_deref()) {
        Ok(t) => t,
        Err(e) => {
            eprint!("{}", e);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    };

    let engine = Engine::new(
        enable_opt.as_deref(),
        disable_opt.as_deref(),
        disable_builtin_keywords,
        custom_highlights,
        theme,
    );

    let is_stdout_tty = crossterm::tty::IsTty::is_tty(&io::stdout());

    // Print mode if -p set or if reading from stdin and stdout not TTY
    let is_print_mode = print || (!is_stdout_tty && file_opt.is_none() && exec_opt.is_none());

    if is_print_mode {
        run_print_mode(file_opt, exec_opt, follow, &engine);
    } else {
        run_pager_mode(file_opt, exec_opt, follow, pager_opt, &engine);
    }
}

fn run_print_mode(
    file_opt: Option<&String>,
    exec_opt: Option<&String>,
    _follow: bool,
    engine: &Engine,
) {
    let stdout = io::stdout();
    let mut handle = stdout.lock();

    if let Some(exec_cmd) = exec_opt {
        if let Ok(mut child) = Command::new("sh")
            .arg("-c")
            .arg(exec_cmd)
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .spawn()
        {
            if let Some(child_stdout) = child.stdout.take() {
                let reader = BufReader::new(child_stdout);
                for line_res in reader.lines() {
                    if let Ok(line) = line_res {
                        let highlighted = engine.highlight_line(&line);
                        if writeln!(handle, "{}", highlighted).is_err() {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    } else if let Some(file_path_str) = file_opt {
        let path = Path::new(file_path_str);
        if !path.exists() {
            eprintln!("Error:   ⚠ \x1b[33m{}\x1b[0m: No such file or directory\n", file_path_str);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }

        if let Ok(file) = File::open(path) {
            let reader = BufReader::new(file);
            for line_res in reader.lines() {
                if let Ok(line) = line_res {
                    let highlighted = engine.highlight_line(&line);
                    if writeln!(handle, "{}", highlighted).is_err() {
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        // Stdin
        let stdin = io::stdin();
        let reader = stdin.lock();
        for line_res in reader.lines() {
            if let Ok(line) = line_res {
                let highlighted = engine.highlight_line(&line);
                if writeln!(handle, "{}", highlighted).is_err() {
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn run_pager_mode(
    file_opt: Option<&String>,
    exec_opt: Option<&String>,
    follow: bool,
    pager_opt: Option<&String>,
    engine: &Engine,
) {
    if let Some(file_path_str) = file_opt {
        let path = Path::new(file_path_str);
        if !path.exists() {
            eprintln!("Error:   ⚠ \x1b[33m{}\x1b[0m: No such file or directory\n", file_path_str);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }

    let temp_file = match Builder::new().prefix("tailspin.temp.").tempfile() {
        Ok(tf) => tf,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("Error creating temp file: {}\n", e);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    };

    let temp_path = temp_file.path().to_path_buf();
    let temp_path_str = temp_path.to_string_lossy().to_string();

    let mut writer = io::BufWriter::new(File::create(&temp_path).unwrap());

    if let Some(file_path_str) = file_opt {
        if let Ok(file) = File::open(file_path_str) {
            let reader = BufReader::new(file);
            for line_res in reader.lines() {
                if let Ok(line) = line_res {
                    let highlighted = engine.highlight_line(&line);
                    let _ = writeln!(writer, "{}", highlighted);
                }
            }
        }
    } else if let Some(exec_cmd) = exec_opt {
        if let Ok(mut child) = Command::new("sh")
            .arg("-c")
            .arg(exec_cmd)
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .spawn()
        {
            if let Some(child_stdout) = child.stdout.take() {
                let reader = BufReader::new(child_stdout);
                for line_res in reader.lines() {
                    if let Ok(line) = line_res {
                        let highlighted = engine.highlight_line(&line);
                        let _ = writeln!(writer, "{}", highlighted);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        let stdin = io::stdin();
        let reader = stdin.lock();
        for line_res in reader.lines() {
            if let Ok(line) = line_res {
                let highlighted = engine.highlight_line(&line);
                let _ = writeln!(writer, "{}", highlighted);
            }
        }
    }
    let _ = writer.flush();

    let pager_cmd_str = if let Some(custom) = pager_opt {
        custom.replace("[FILE]", &temp_path_str)
    } else {
        let follow_flag = if follow { "+F " } else { "" };
